interaction: Pop iridescent soap bubbles over the bathtub hero (tap, click or the Pop button), then build a groom: pick a size and coat and the SVG dog springs to its new proportions and fur (smooth, fluffy, curly or long) with a shoulder-height marker, while add-on chips update a sample price and time estimate in the 'Your groom' card; breed badges load presets, and the booking form ends on an honest demo message.
notes: Prices and times are sample figures. Reduced motion shows static bubbles and an instant dog change.
